_key.description: Motif key and Ensembl protein ID joined by an underscore.

_to.description: Handle of the Ensembl protein for the transcription factor the motif models.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term GO:0003677 (DNA binding), as a handle into ontology_terms. The identifier is a molecular function, not a biological process.

source.description: HOCOMOCO version the motif was taken from.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the file's fileset metadata: 'observed data' for a motif derived from ChIP-seq.

method.description: Model collection that produced this motif, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file the HOCOMOCO PWM bundle was read from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, inverse_name, biological_process, source, class, method, files_filesets
